text: APPROVE. The extracted `AddGoEmbedRef` has the same logic as the old inner-loop body, with each `continue` correctly turned into `return`, and it removes the ternary, the `||` conditions and the nested `if`s from `CollectGoEmbedRefs`, so its cognitive complexity should fall well below 15. I could only see the diff, not the full file, so I assumed `hostEmbeds` is a `List<HostEmbedRef>` and that `rel` and `directory` are in scope in the caller. The call site passes them as if they are.
